title: 1:1 prep - Priya Shah (report) — Liam Owen
content:
Agenda for 1:1 (30m) with Priya — 2026-03-03

1) Quick status (5m)
- Priya: current focus = kv-cache perf work + LRU eviction tuning for 2.1.
- Blockers: flaky e2e test on batcher (intermittent), unclear perf delta in nightly runs.
- Wins: landed quantized kernel prototype (PR #412), saw ~18% CPU reduction in local bench.

2) Top priorities & scope alignment (10m)
- Short term (next 2 wks): stabilize batcher e2e tests, complete LRU eviction config flags, address perf regression reported in nightly 2026-02-28.
- Medium term (quarter): get kv-cache full rollout on Dedicated, measure token/sec improvements and p95 latency impact.
- Ask: confirm which regressions are acceptable tradeoffs for quantization (we need pass/fail criteria).

3) Blockers deep-dive (7m)
- Batcher flakes: repro steps (local) -> unit tests pass, e2e fails on CI intermittently at shutdown path. Hypothesis: race in worker shutdown timer. Action: Priya to add more debug logs and a CI job with --run-heavy for 24h. (Action: Priya by 2026-03-06)
- Nightly perf delta: 2026-02-28 nightly shows +6% p95 latency when quantized model used under long seq. Need trace sampling. Action: create perf trace capture ticket and pair with release-engineering. (Action: Liam to open ENG-2410 and tag Priya)

4) Career / growth check (5m)
- Priya expressed interest in owning a cross-team perf initiative (batcher + kv-cache + kernel selection).
- Discuss stepping stones: lead a small project (Q2), mentor internship project, present learnings at eng tech share.
- Action: draft charter for perf initiative and share with Eng Leads. (Action: Priya start draft by 2026-03-10)

5) Admin / housekeeping (3m)
- PTO reminder: Priya out 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-22 — plan handoffs for any rollout that week.
- Check on FY26 goals: needs a small update (add quantization milestones). (Action: Priya update goal doc and share link)

Notes-to-self / things to ask during the 1:1:
- Ask for concrete signal: what metric would make Priya feel comfortable rolling quantized variant to Dedicated? (p95 < baseline + 2%?)
- Confirm resource needs: does Priya need more CI minutes / a dedicated perf runner?
- Encourage pairing with Release Eng on trace capture to speed root cause.
- Emphasize cross-team visibility: schedule 15m sync with Platform/Release next week.

Follow-up action item list (post-1:1) — OWNER / ETA / STATUS
- Open perf trace ticket with release-eng and attach recent nightly artifacts — Liam / 2026-03-04 / TODO
- Add extra logging and a stress CI job to reproduce batcher shutdown race — Priya / 2026-03-06 / IN_PROGRESS
- Draft charter for "Perf Initiative" (objectives, stakeholders, first deliverables) — Priya / 2026-03-10 / TODO
- Update FY26 goal doc to include quantization milestones — Priya / 2026-03-05 / TODO
- Add canary rollout plan for kv-cache on Dedicated (stages + rollback criteria) — Liam + Priya / 2026-03-12 / TODO
- Sync invite: platform-release 15m intro to trace capture plan — Liam / 2026-03-05 / DONE

Misc snippets to paste into follow-up Slack DM / Confluence:
- \"Thanks for the sync — quick recap: focus on batcher e2e stability, debug logs + stress ci, perf trace ticket opened (ENG-2410), charter draft by 3/10. I'll follow up on canary plan next week.\"
- Confluence blurb for charter: \"Goal: reduce p95 inference latency variance across model variants by 30% by EOY through coordinated improvements across batcher, kv-cache, and kernel selection. Initial scope: stabilize batcher shutdown sequence and enable A/B canary for quantized kernels on Dedicated.\"

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we have budget for an additional nightly perf runner (paid CI)? Who signs off? (cc: release-eng manager)
- What are the exact observability dashboards SRE wants for kv-cache rollout (logs vs traces vs metrics)? Need a checklist.

Quick reference links to paste in convo:
- Perf PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412
- Nightly run: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/job/serving-nightly/2026-02-28/artifacts
- Related Jira: ENG-2345 (kv-cache eviction), ENG-2410 (perf trace capture - to open)

End notes:
- Keep this doc private (personal prep) until after the sync — will copy summary to shared team notes.
- Keep action items shallow and measurable.

-- Liam
